title: The town that was called Wells
text: Keene was founded in 1876 as a railroad town, and its first name was Wells, for a local rancher called Madison P. Wells. It was renamed for James P. Keene, a financier who settled in the area. The post office here opened in 1879, closed two years later, and opened again in 1885.
